sections.rule:
## Abstract
- Provide a clear and concise summary of the entire paper.
- Include purpose, scope, and key findings.
- Mention methodology if relevant.
- Ensure the abstract is self-contained and easy to read.
- Highlight main contributions without unnecessary detail

## Introduction
- Introduce the research topic with necessary background.
- Explain the importance and relevance of the topic.
- Identify the research problem or gap.
- State the objectives of the paper clearly.
- Outline the structure of the paper.

## Taxonomy
- Present a clear classification of existing approaches.
- Define classification criteria logically.
- Organize content into coherent categories.
- Show relationships and differences between approaches.
- Ensure the structure is easy to follow.

## Comparison

- Highlight strengths and weaknesses of each method.
- Identify key differences and similarities.
- Focus on insights rather than simple descriptions.
- Use structured representations if necessary.
